'''Rekara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Diplomatic Corps|Diplomatic Corps]]. She was the faithful [[retainer]] of diplomat [[Mors Odrion]], and joined him on a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. While on the planet, the [[Sedrian]] [[Bishop of war]] [[Karak]] and his [[Karak's renegades|renegades]] captured Odrion, but Rekara managed to escape and traveled to [[Delta Base]] on [[New Kisge]] to look for help.

==Biography==
Rekara served as the [[retainer]] to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] dignitary [[Mors Odrion]]. The pair worked at recruiting and securing supplies for the growing Rebellion. While carrying out their duties, Rekara and Odrion began to hear rumors of a newly discovered strange [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] and the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison|garrison]] that had been established on it. Investigating further, Odrion decided to get more directly involved in the war effort; along with Rekara, he set course for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]].<ref name="BGS" />

Despite the warnings from the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], Rekara and Odrion arrive safely at Sedri. The planet glowed with seemingly golden [[Ocean/Legends|seas]]. Rekara and Odrion went in search of the source of the glow, hiding their vessel in a rocky cove. The source of the glow faded, and Rekara and Odrion were captured by a [[Karak's renegades|group]] of [[Sedrian]]s, the world's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="BGS" />

The leader of the renegades, [[Karak]], used a piece of [[Golden Sun coral|coral]] to steal information from Odrion's mind, including information on the Rebellion, the Empire, and Odrion's mission to Sedri. While Odrion was kept under constant guard during his incarceration, Rekara was left alone in a locked chamber. She managed to escape when there were no guards present. Knowing that she could not save Odrion, Rekara instead stole the piece of coral that had been used to take information from his mind. Fleeing to their hidden ship, Rekara was unaware that her actions with the coral had caused it to die; the cry of the coral echoed deep into the Mon Calamari's mind, causing Rekara to go insane. Despite this, Rekara was still able to launch the ship and set course for the Alliance's [[Delta Base]].<ref name="BGS" />

Arriving at the Alliance base, Rekara stumbled out of the ship, half-crazed and raving about the Golden Sun. A rescue and investigatory mission was put together, undertaken by a group of Alliance agents. Rekara, slowly recovering from the effects of the dying coral and only occasionally lucid, was placed on the mission at the request of [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] who believed that she would be valuable to the mission. Once on Sedri, Rekara's behavior became less and less crazed, culminating in her eventually returning the piece of coral to the [[sun caves]] below [[Fitsay]]. Along with the Sedrians [[Pek]] and [[Fala (Sedrian)|Fala]], Rekara helped one of the Alliance team, who had been chosen as the [[Golden Sun]]'s champion, to defeat [[Karak]] and release the Golden Sun from its confinement.<ref name="BGS" />

==Personality and traits==
Rekara possessed a youthful and daring adventurous spirit. She had a sharp and quick mind, but her encounter with the Golden Sun coral left her muddled and crazed.<ref name="BGS" />
